overview: The PADMA Scheme (Programme to Accelerate Development for MSME Advancement) is a five-year block-level economic transformation policy notified by the Haryana Government on August 17, 2023, aiming to develop MSME industrial clusters across all 143 blocks of the state's 22 districts. It focuses on creating enabling infrastructure, knowledge creation, awareness generation, and handholding support to accelerate entrepreneurship, strengthen industrial infrastructure, and generate sustainable employment at the grassroots level. The scheme includes multiple sub-schemes such as Capital Investment Subsidy, Cluster Infrastructure Development, Designing & Branding, Entrepreneurship Acceleration, and Interest Subsidy, each targeting specific aspects of MSME development.
objectives: Set up a new MSME cluster in each block, on about 4000 acres of land
Enable setting up of 10,000+ new enterprises
Attract new investment of INR 25,000-30,000 Crores
Encouraging holistic socio-economic development and a robust industrial ecosystem at block level
Empower the state’s youth to set up new enterprises by providing them opportunities to grow and be a part of the formal economy
Promotion of locally relevant products and provide an opportunity to state farmers to broaden their horizon – from producers to processors

Designing and implementing developmental interventions focused on micro and small enterprises at block level, by leveraging cluster approach, to give a thrust to sustainable employment and entrepreneurship opportunities
eligibility: The micro and small enterprises inside/outside the approved PADMA cluster shall be eligible under the scheme. The MSEs shall also comply with the following conditions: The unit should have filed Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) and Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM). The unit should be in commercial production. The unit should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the subsidy shall not be released to closed unit. The unit shall remain in regular production for a period of 05 years from date of commercial production. The unit should be engaged in manufacturing/processing of the approved product category of that cluster. The unit shall have to use the PADMA logo on the product manufactured. The land for the project shall be arranged by the promoter either by purchase or on registered lease deed of at least 10 years. The unit availing incentive under this scheme will not be eligible to obtain incentives under any capital subsidy/similar scheme of other policies of the State Government. The CLU/NOC/Industrial License as applicable obtained by IA for the said PADMA cluster, will be applicable.
benefits: Financial assistance includes capital investment subsidy (up to 30% of eligible investment, max Rs. 30 lakh for women/SC/SHG units and Rs. 25 lakh for others inside PADMA cluster; half for outside), interest subsidy (reimbursement of interest @6% p.a. or actual rate, max Rs. 20 lakh/year inside and Rs. 10 lakh/year outside), entrepreneurship acceleration grant (Rs. 20 lakh inside and Rs. 10 lakh outside per startup for proof of concept), and designing/branding/marketing support (50% reimbursement, max Rs. 10 lakh/year inside and Rs. 5 lakh/year outside). Non-financial benefits include access to Common Facility Centres (CFCs), Business Development Centres (BDCs), plug-and-play facilities, skill development, market linkages, credit facilitation, mentorship, and strategic linkages with BDS providers and OEMs.
financial_support: Financial support varies by sub-scheme: Under PADMA Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme, 30% subsidy on eligible capital investment (max Rs. 30 lakh for women/SC/SHG units, Rs. 25 lakh for others) inside PADMA cluster; half for units outside. Under PADMA Interest Subsidy Scheme, reimbursement of interest @6% p.a. or actual rate paid, whichever is less, up to Rs. 20 lakh per financial year inside and Rs. 10 lakh outside. Under PADMA Entrepreneurship Acceleration Scheme, financial assistance of Rs. 20 lakh for startups inside and Rs. 10 lakh outside per innovative idea for proof of concept. Under PADMA Designing, Branding, Marketing & Exports Promotion Scheme, 50% reimbursement of expenses, max Rs. 10 lakh/year inside and Rs. 5 lakh/year outside. Under PADMA Cluster Infrastructure Development Scheme (PCIDS), 50% to 85% financial assistance, max Rs. 35 Crore for up to 50 acres and Rs. 45 Crore for more than 50 acres, based on block category (B: 50%, C: 75%, D: 85%).
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to Rs. 30 lakh for women/SC/SHG owned micro and small units inside PADMA cluster; Rs. 25 lakh for other units inside; Rs. 15 lakh for women/SC/SHG and Rs. 12.50 lakh for others outside PADMA cluster
application_process: 1. Apply on the prescribed form (Annexure-I) for the respective sub-scheme (e.g., Capital Investment Subsidy, Interest Subsidy, etc.) along with required documents. 2. Submit the application to the Director General, Directorate of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Haryana, via the web portal within the stipulated time (e.g., 03 months from start of commercial production or date of scheme notification, whichever is later). 3. The application is scrutinized by the Joint Director/Deputy Director, District MSME Centre. 4. Deficiencies, if any, are communicated in writing within 07 days, with 10 days to rectify. 5. If deficiencies are not rectified, the claim is recommended for rejection. 6. The Competent Authority (Head of Department, Directorate of MSME, Haryana) sanctions the assistance after compliance of formalities. 7. For certain schemes like Cluster Infrastructure Development, progress reports and utilization certificates are required at each tranche of disbursement.

deadlines: The scheme shall commence with effect from the date of re-notification of PADMA policy i.e., 17.08.2023 and shall remain in operation for a period of 5 years up to 16.08.2028 or till the validity of the PADMA policy. Applicants shall have to apply on the prescribed form along with complete documents within 03 months from the start of commercial production or from the date of notification of the scheme or from the date of re-notification of PADMA policy, whichever is later.
implementing_agency: Directorate of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Haryana (Department of Industries & Commerce, Haryana)
caveats: The unit availing incentive under this scheme will not be eligible to obtain incentives under any capital subsidy/similar scheme of other policies of the State Government.
The unit shall remain in regular production for a period of 05 years from date of commercial production.
The land for the project shall be arranged by the promoter either by purchase or on registered lease deed of at least 10 years.

Maximum number of cases eligible per PADMA cluster to avail the benefit under the Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme: Maximum up to 20 units in first 5 PADMA clusters, up to 10 units in next 10 PADMA clusters (6th to 15th), up to 5 units in rest (above 16th), and up to 100 units outside PADMA block across the state on first come first basis.

For PADMA Entrepreneurship Acceleration Scheme: Benefit provided to maximum 10 startup units per PADMA cluster and 50 startups outside the PADMA cluster during the policy period on first come first basis.

For PADMA Interest Subsidy Scheme: The PADMA interest subsidy shall be allowed for 05 consecutive financial years, from the date of re-notification of said policy or date of loan sanctioned/disbursed, whichever is later.

For PADMA Designing, Branding, Marketing & Exports Promotion Scheme: The unit may avail the benefit every year till 05 consecutive financial years, from the date of re-notification of said policy or as extended by State Government from time to time.
The grant shall not be used for procurement/purchase of land under PADMA Cluster Infrastructure Development Scheme.
IA shall have to ensure setting up of 20 manufacturing MSMEs (having FCI of at least INR 25 Crore in total) in the PADMA Cluster under PADMA Cluster Infrastructure Development Scheme.
IA shall submit the progress reports to the Directorate of MSME mentioning the project progress and expenditure as and when required.
IA shall be exclusively responsible for the day-to-day running of the PADMA enabling infrastructural facilities.
IA may sell/lease industrial plots to MSMEs engaged in manufacturing & allied activities of PADMA approved products across the entire value chain of one sector or any activity approved by SLSC-PADMA.
